🌍 We're Beating The World ENCOURAGING
The Lobster League's average GW3 score was 51.5 points — comfortably ahead of the
global FPL average of 36 . Nobody here hit the global high score of 107, but as a group, this
league is playing sharper than the average manager worldwide. Something to be proud of.
🪑 Bench Fodder Hall of Shame FUNNY
Even the league leader isn't immune: gian jaen wasted 16 points on the bench this
gameweek — the most in the league. Alfonso Castrejon (15) and Khang Dang (14) round out a
top 3 that proves winning and bad bench-ordering can absolutely coexist.
💰 The £100m+ Arms Race SERIOUS
Combined squad value across all 21 managers: £2,102.5m (avg £100.12m each). Drin
Pacuku quietly fields the single most valuable squad in the league at £100.8m — currently
only good enough for 15th place. Value doesn't win titles; decisions do.
🔮 The Dream Team Blind Spot INTERESTING
Of the Official GW3 Dream Team's 11 players, 6 are owned by literally nobody in this
league (Suzuki, Mitchell, Bogle, Vuskovic, Barnes, Tavernier). There's a whole parallel universe
of points nobody here is touching — see Page 4 for exactly who they are.

EDITORIAL DOSSIER — CRITICAL DECISIONS THAT DEFINED GAMEWEEK 3
🚨 The Blunder of the Week — Alfonso's Double Flop LOSS OF 1ST PLACE
Entering GW3 as the league leader (171 pts), Alfonso Castrejon (El Cochiloco) executed a double transfer: selling Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Bryan Mbeumo to buy Yoane Wissa (£6.1m) and
Rayan Cherki (£5.9m) .
The Outcome: Wissa blanked (1 pt vs BOU) and Cherki subbed o ffat 65' (3 pts vs COV) for 4 points combined . Meanwhile, Mbeumo scored 8 pts and Calvert-Lewin delivered, contributing to a
slide from 1st down to 4th place .
💎 The Masterstroke — Gian Jaen's Tactical Surge #15 ➔ #1 IN 2 WEEKS
gian jaen (Gaucho F.C.) engineered the most e fficient window in the league:
• Brobbey ➔ Alexander Isak: 13 pts (2 goals + 3 bonus) vs Ipswich.
• Gabriel ➔ Maxim De Cuyper: 4 pts (assist vs Leeds), dodging Arsenal's tough fixture.
• Held Enzo Le Fée: Resisted selling and banked 8 pts (goal + bonus vs Brentford).
Anchored by Haaland (3xC, 27 pts) and a complete Man Utd stack (Mbeumo 8, Shaw 4, Bruno 2) , Gian posted 77 points to claim 1st place with 231 total.
⚡ The Rogue 3xC Renegade 89 PTS GW HIGH
1st-year rookie Joshua Clarke (Gunner4Lyfe) rejected the 8-manager Haaland 3xC template
and placed his Triple Captain armband on Alexander Isak .
The Payo ff : Isak scored twice inside 9 minutes, returning 39 points from one slot to propel
Joshua from 11th up into 2nd place (222 pts) .
🌪 The Repeat Offender — Back-to-Back Hits CAPTAIN BRUNO
Nick Revia (captain bruno) took a -12 point hit in GW2 (4 transfers on a 1-FT budget), then
did it again in GW3 (Rúben, Martinez, Rice, Gakpo ➔ White, Hall, Enzo, Rogers) for another
-12 .
That's -24 points lost to hits across two gameweeks — the only manager in the league to
take a hit even once, let alone twice. Currently 12th with 173 points.
🧗 The Great Climbers MOMENTUM
• gian jaen: #15 in GW1 ➔ #1 Overall ( ▲ +14 spots).
• Alexis Segura: #18 in GW1 ➔ #7 Overall ( ▲ +11 spots).
• Joshua Clarke: #11 in GW2 ➔ #2 Overall (a mid-season surge).
• Jose Castrejon: #7 in GW1 ➔ #3 Overall ( ▲ +4 spots, aided by a well-earned autosub).
📉 Steepest Regressors FALLERS
• Abner Chavez: #8 ➔ #16 ( ▼ -8, captained Watkins to Saudi Arabia).
• Cameron Walker: #1 ➔ #9 ( ▼ -8, Saka captaincy blanked for 2 pts).
• Marie Drosche: #10 ➔ #17 ( ▼ -7, inactivity & Watkins captaincy).
• Aleksa Divcic: #3 ➔ #10 ( ▼ -7, 4 defensive blanks in GW3).
👑 The Captaincy Cult FUNNY
11 of 21 managers (52%) captained Erling Haaland this gameweek. The other 10 split across
Isak, B.Fernandes (x2), João Pedro (x2), Watkins (x2), Saka, Virgil, and Šeško. Groupthink is
alive and well in The Lobster League — and it worked out fine for most of them.
🔁 The Untouched XI vs. The Serial Tinkerer CONTRAST
Jose Castrejon, Nico Zarzaua, Abner Chavez & Marie Drosche have made zero transfers
all season — same GW1 squad, three gameweeks later. Meanwhile Drin Pacuku has made
13 transfers across the same span. Jose currently sits 3rd. Drin sits 15th. Sometimes the
best move is no move.
🌱 It's Only Gameweek 3 — A Word For Anyone at the Bottom ENCOURAGING
This league has three managers with 7–8 years of FPL history, and their own records prove early gameweeks mean very little: gian jaen finished the 2019/20 season a modest top-59%
worldwide — then finished 2021/22 in the top 4% just two seasons later, and is this year's current league leader. A rough GW3 is 3 out of 38 gameweeks. There is a genuinely enormous amount
of season left for everyone currently sitting in the bottom half.
